close_reason: Expanded blob_exists doc with explicit RFC 8621 §5.8 citation, explanation of the notFound/notParsable distinction, and why there is no default — making the consequence of non-implementation clear to backend authors.
description: backend.rs lines 317-329: blob_exists default impl always returns true, routing all Email/parse failures to notParsable. The doc says 'Override for correct RFC conformance' but does not cite RFC 8621 §5.8 by name, does not say which client-visible behavior breaks (clients cannot distinguish 'blob does not exist' from 'blob is not parsable'), and does not explain that the default is intentionally wrong for testing convenience. A backend author who does not read §5.8 will ship a non-conformant implementation with no warning. Add a concrete explanation of the RFC requirement and the consequence of not overriding.
title: blob_exists default silently breaks RFC 8621 §5.8 split
